content: Reyansh Tiwari called insurance agent Vikram Patel to check the status of his health policy (#HC-2023-9876). Vikram informed him that the policy expired on 15/09/2026. Vikram explained that while new claims cannot be filed during this lapsed state, the policy can be renewed within a 30-day window with a small lapse fee and a new term starting 01/10/2026. The new annual premium is $1,250 (up from $1,100). Reyansh requested the renewal quote to be sent via email before making a final decision.

action_items: Send renewal quote via email to the customer
